verdicts.why: Named layoff at Kestrel Automation Works affects 85 people in the same metro as Solstice Yards, an hours-old signal.
verdicts.hook: Saw the news about Kestrel's layoff and wanted to reach out directly rather than wait for a posting.
verdicts.edge: The equity grant refreshes every year and relocation covers moving costs plus weeks of temporary housing, which should land well for someone leaving a comparable hardware employer.

verdicts.why: Verity Sensing Corp is cutting manufacturing and test staff after a down round, a sensor-array maker in the same metro as Solstice Yards.
verdicts.hook: Saw the news about Verity's restructuring, reaching out before a formal layoff posts.
verdicts.edge: The 1% starting equity grant could offset some of the uncertainty of joining right after a down round.

verdicts.why: Redline Fabrication's full site closure affects 40 people with direct craft overlap in precision fabrication.
verdicts.hook: Reference the Redline closure and the shared craft of precision fabrication work.
verdicts.edge: Relocation support and a flexible hybrid schedule could matter for someone commuting from Boulder.

verdicts.why: Palisade Robotics missed a funding milestone and is reportedly restructuring, an early but real signal at a comparable robotics company.
verdicts.hook: Open with the funding news gently, framing it as a heads-up rather than an assumption.
verdicts.edge: A dedicated mentor for the first 90 days could reassure someone moving away from a distressed startup.

verdicts.why: Ironhaven's 22-person layoff is small but named and dated, with plausible craft overlap in precision machining.
verdicts.hook: Reference the Ironhaven layoff plainly; the craft overlap is real but not a perfect match.
verdicts.edge: A $2,000 annual learning stipend could help someone reskilling from machining toward sensor test work.
